### Mentor recognition, Delta Waterfowl Foundation
<span class="media-meta">Delta Waterfowl Foundation · July 2026</span>

Recognized for three years of mentoring UBC Okanagan students through Delta Waterfowl's University Hunting Program: helping new hunters prepare for their first hunt, loaning gear, and mentoring in the field, along with introductions to fishing, trapping, archery, and turkey hunting.

> "Megan has made hunting more accessible while building confidence in the field."

[Read the post on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/story.php?story_fbid=1460829489422035&id=100064849926108)
